Drives a hinge or a slider. Mode 0 turns the motor off, mode 1 drives to a speed (degrees per second, world units per second), mode 2 drives to a position (degrees, world units). The motor never pushes harder than `max_force` (torque for a hinge, force for a slider), so a weak motor can be stopped by a load.
@param constraint A hinge or slider constraint.
@param mode 0 off, 1 speed, 2 position.
@param target The speed or position to reach.
@param max_force The largest torque or force the motor may use, 0 or more.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
